# Archive admission fixtures

`example-pack` and `color-tools` derive from the registry service's
`fixtures/packs` at commit `84a62ae10c257f00f1c5b737a130a41ee227b54b`, with
versioned manifests and import packages matching their distribution names.
The contract tests preserve their wheel admission metadata, doctor findings
and executable schema signatures. Public CI needs no service checkout or
credentials. Operator timings and diagnostic paths are not stable contracts.
